description: This file declares the HttpRequest class used for handling HTTP requests within the rialto::servermanager namespace. It includes methods for retrieving request details such as method, command, post data, and parameters, as well as a reply method to send responses. The class encapsulates a connection object and request data members.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP request, providing access to request details and a method to send responses.

methods.name: HttpRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpRequest object with a connection and request info.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request (e.g., GET, POST).

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command or endpoint associated with the request.

methods.name: getPostData
methods.description: Returns the POST data payload of the request.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters extracted from the request.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Sends a response message back over the connection.
